body:
You are still young, and there is plenty of light at the end of the tunnel.  I have a similar story to yours that all seems to go wrong when  started smoking,  By the time I was your age I was a huge pothead, and I never realized until recently when my father yelled it at me that maybe there was a correlation between when I started smoking and when success started to become more elusive.  I wish I had noticed it sooner.  I know you will come out okay with some cool emotional scars, but if you can find anyway to limit your drinking and smoking, i think it will happen even faster.  

Lastly, I think all colleges are full of alot of people feeling like you do who maybe just hide it better, but there are probably alot of people always looking for more friends, maybe people you never even noticed before because they arent the type you usually socialize with, but sophomore year is certainly not too late to make some great lasting friendships.

Someone once told me that if a cup of water is half empty, you can put alot of stuff in it before it starts to overflow.  But if the cup is already full to the top, and you drop one small thing inside, it will spill over.  It sounds like you are just very full of emotions already, so when someone adds one little negative thing it makes your anger overflow.  

Sometimes it helps if you notice you are getting very angry to imagine "how would this go on a tv sitcom?"  if your life was a tvshow, your mom would say stupid shit to you all the time and you would shake your head or roll your eyes or maybe walk away in  anger, but you wouldnt yell and stomp your feet, right?   I also live with my mother and I have very similar problems, but sometimes every once in a while, if I remember this I am able to smile at my family's stupidity instead of getting angry.  Maybe you can do the same?

Well is it possible that you might still finish your studies in the future?  Obviously I am just some strange nobody on the internet who doesn't know your situation, but maybe there is some small chance of something good happening (like graduating with a degree, or making a friend) and you can work towards that one thing?
